title: Temporary duty at the Pentagon handling Vietnam War protesters

tellings.quote: dur during the Vietnam War I was I was brought TDY temporary duty to the Pentagon because demonstrators were throwing balloons full of blood

plain: During the Vietnam War, sometime between 1967 and 1969, Joe McMoneagle says he was sent to the Pentagon on "TDY", military shorthand for a temporary posting, because protesters were throwing balloons full of blood. McMoneagle tells Michels this as part of his own service history.
